ctaHeading: Ravenhall's stair specialists are ready — let's build your project.
aboutText: With 15 years of experience, Planet Stairs Melbourne has been Ravenhall's trusted specialist in quality timber staircases, balustrades, and handrails. We manufacture and supply a comprehensive range of newel posts, stainless steel and wrought iron features, and custom-designed stair solutions. From contemporary open designs to traditional curved geometric staircases, our skilled team delivers exceptional craftsmanship for homes and businesses across Melbourne's west.
servicesText: Planet Stairs Melbourne offers a full range of staircase services from our Ravenhall workshop. We specialise in timber staircase installation, balustrades, handrails, and custom newel posts. Our 15 years of experience means we can deliver contemporary, traditional, or bespoke designs using quality materials including timber, stainless steel, and wrought iron.

services.title: Timber Staircases
services.desc: Design and installation of quality timber staircases in contemporary, traditional, and custom open styles for Melbourne homes.

services.title: Balustrades
services.desc: Comprehensive range including stainless steel bars, wrought iron twists, timber posts, and wire balustrade options.

services.title: Handrails
services.desc: Premium timber and stainless steel handrails with professional nosing and bullnose finishing for safety and style.

services.title: Newel Posts
services.desc: Manufacturing and supplying quality newel posts in timber, stainless steel, and wrought iron to suit any staircase.

services.title: Custom Designs
services.desc: Bespoke curved, geometric, and open staircase designs tailored to your specific space and aesthetic preferences.

services.title: Steel & Wire Features
services.desc: Stainless steel round and square bars, wrought iron twists, and wire options for modern balustrade systems.
